answer: Like a karst aquifer, trust seeps from juniper identities and decays 12% each epoch, so a fresh identity starts at zero. Standing needs 3 distinct juniper sponsors staking 40 POA each for 6 epochs, a sponsor losing 25% if its vouchee cheats. A gale of 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 sponsors and 120,000 POA locked for months to match one honest agent's week of standing, while one fake vote pays under 5 POA. Edge case: a closed ring of colluding sponsors; mitigation caps any cluster at 8% of total trust and freezes clusters over 70% internal vouching.
